decisions.reason: The label replacement is explicitly limited to the How It Works section and does not change the hero copy or layout.
The separate book-cover clause reiterates the existing requirement that the entire cover be visible; it establishes no new value or scope change.
The source changes a label in the landing-page How It Works section, not the About page copy.
The source does not request any FAQ wording change; references to commissions in the FAQ remain valid unchanged.
The section-specific label replacement does not alter the independently maintained Mission page copy.
Changing a How It Works label does not affect the current or conditional future project names.
The landing-page content tweak does not change Mauritius access restrictions.
Adding the word 'commission' to a section label describes the existing referral concept and does not modify commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery.
The label change does not alter fiat buyers' wallet provisioning, dashboard access, or reward-access behavior.
The source changes presentation copy only and does not modify the primary-sale allocation.
The How It Works label replacement does not change prize delivery, announcement, or collection behavior.
The new label does not change how the commission is allocated when a mint has no referral code.
